description: Sector overlay for non-governmental organizations, incorporated trustees, charities, donor-funded bodies, associations, foundations, and civil-society documentation in Nigeria.

metadata.scope: Nigeria-only sector overlay controls for NGO. Intended to be used with core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis reviewed against official Nigerian statutes, regulations, regulator rules, codes, directives and standards current to 2026-08-30. This deterministic screening pack requires qualified human review before legal or regulatory reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Companies and Allied Matters Act, 2020 and current CAC Incorporated Trustees framework
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / Corporate Affairs Commission

primary_sources.name: Nigeria Tax Act 2025, Nigeria Tax Administration Act 2025 and Nigeria Revenue Service (Establishment) Act 2025, effective from 2026 as applicable
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / Nigeria Revenue Service

primary_sources.name: Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022; EFCC AML/CFT/CPF Regulations for DNFBPs 2024 and NPO TF-Abuse Regulations 2023 where applicable
primary_sources.issuer: SCUML / EFCC / Federal Republic of Nigeria
used_for: AML/CFT registration and controls where NGO activities are in scope

primary_sources.name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 and NDP Act-GAID 2025
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / Nigeria Data Protection Commission

rules.title: CAC incorporated trustee or registration evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for CAC, incorporated trustees, certificate of incorporation, constitution, trustees, or registration-number evidence.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this sector control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: A qualified Nigerian compliance/legal reviewer must confirm applicability, legal sufficiency, sector context, and whether absence of textual evidence should be treated as non-compliance.
source_basis: CAC current Incorporated Trustees registration process
